Celebrated for his remarkable contributions to Hindi cinema, Johnny is still actively engaged in upcoming projects.

title: Madhuri recalls 5:30 am breakfasts for Dr Shriram Nene
description: Madhuri Dixit moved to the U.S. after marrying Dr. Shriram Nene in 1999. On Simi Garewal’s show, she recalled waking at 5:30 am to make his breakfast before surgeries, savouring every minute. Unaware of her stardom, he hadn’t seen her films. The couple has two sons, and she returned to Bollywood in 2007.

title: Saif Ali Khan says his two-year supply of ghee and ‘KBC’ cheque are still pending
description: During a delightful appearance on Netflix’s The Great Indian Kapil Show, Saif Ali Khan jokingly admitted he is still eagerly awaiting his promised ghee and prize cheque. Anirudh Ravichander enriches the film’s soundtrack, collaborating once again with both the director and the veteran star. description: ‘Drishyam 3: The Conclusion’, starring Ajay Devgn, continues its theatrical run in its third week. The film’s worldwide gross has reached Rs. 528.77 crore. As Day 17 live tracking continues, the next major domestic target is the Rs. 350 crore India net mark.

title: ‘My grandson is a fan of Hiphop Tamizha Adhi’: Deva’s final stage appearance

Adhi fondly remembered Deva's profound impact on the music landscape, emphasizing their shared journey.

title: Vijay says Rashmika proposed 100 times; she picks Allu Arjun

title: Scripting starts for Mirzapur Season 4 as Shweta Tripathi seeks fresh arc for Golu
description: ‘Mirzapur’ Season 4 is in development, with director Gurmmeet Singh confirming that scripting is underway after the success of ‘Mirzapur: The Movie’. Shweta Tripathi, who plays Golu Gupta, says she is eager to explore the character’s continuing evolution. She believes Golu’s experiences have changed her and that they have grown together over the years. According to Mid-Day, the production timeline is expected to be finalised by early 2027, with the story continuing after Season 3’s finale.

description: Vijay Deverakonda shared insights on his film 'Ranabaali' at a promotional event in Vijayawada. The film aims to convey a mass-market interpretation of historical cinema inspired by films like 'Braveheart' and 'Schindler’s List'. It explores themes of oppression during British colonial rule in India, particularly during the Madras Famine period. Co-starring Rashmika Mandanna, the film's box office performance has seen fluctuations since its release.

title: ‘Jailer 2’ BO Day 4 [LIVE]: Rajinikanth starrer sets sight on Rs 200 crore

With a total earning of Rs 155.38 crore, it has outpaced other films like 'Jana Nayagan' and 'Karuppu'. The Tamil version has led the charge, bolstered by strong performances and captivating music that keep audiences flocking to theaters.

title: Ravi Teja praises Anandhi’s performance in ‘Garividi Lakshmi’

He particularly praised lead actress Anandhi for her performance in the titular role. Teja also recognized director Gowri Naidu Jammu and producer Krithi Prasad for their contributions to the project. The film honors Reddy Vijaya Lakshmi, a folk artist known for preserving North Andhra traditions.

Praising director Nitesh Tiwari and producer Namit Malhotra, he called it a story every Indian storyteller dreams of telling. With performances from Rishikanth, Sananth, and Keerthy Suresh, it promises to engage audiences. Having garnered acclaim at the Toronto International Film Festival, 'Dorothy' also boasts an evocative soundtrack by the legendary Ilaiyaraaja.
